messages:
Priya Shah: Heads up 1010 we need a short, high-conversion newsletter sequence tied to the benchmark release + webinar. Main KPI: webinar RSVPs and report downloads. Thoughts on cadence?
Noah Rivera: Recommend compact 4-email flow: 1) invite, 2) social proof reminder, 3) last-chance, 4) post-webinar highlights. Plus two downstream drips: recording and TL;DR w/ CTA to download.
Jules Ford: Segmentation plan: paid customers (hand-off to AE), active trials, engaged newsletter (opened >=2 of last 5), dormant subscribers (no opens 90d). Different CTAs per segment: customers -> private invite link, trials -> register + trial tips, engaged -> webinar, dormant -> report download.
Priya Shah: Subject-line test matrix: personalization vs curiosity vs data-led. Example lines:
- "Priya, see how inference costs stack up"
- "New benchmark: X% lower cost on average"
- "Live: behind-the-benchmarks webinar + Q&A"
We'll A/B/C test on engaged cohort only.
Noah Rivera: ESP limits: we can only run 3 subject variants if we create separate sends for the same campaign. Suggest we do sequential holds: seed 5% for A/B/C, pick winner at 24h then roll to remainder.
Deliverability Bot: Note: avoid image-only hero, include plain-text body, and set List-Unsubscribe header. Warmup note: if we send >50k in one burst on a new subdomain, expect ISP throttling.
Jules Ford: Send windows: customers Tue 09:30PT, trials Wed 10:30PT, engaged Thu 08:00PT (split two batches: 08:00 & 09:30), dormant Fri 06:00PT (APAC optimized).
Priya Shah: UTM rules: utm_campaign=benchmark_q3_launch, utm_medium=email, utm_source=newsletter, utm_content={{segment}}_{{variant}}. Make sure links use our CDN redirect.
Noah Rivera: Suppression rules: anyone who downloaded the benchmark in last 45 days, unsubscribed from product, hard bounces in last 90d, and anyone in the AE opt-out list. Also suppress if email engagement flags as spam_trap.
Jules Ford: QA checklist: seeds (support@, product@, 3 personal inboxes), validate personalization tokens, test render on mobile, Outlook web and Outlook desktop, verify List-Unsubscribe header, check AMP link fallback.
Priya Shah: Creative brief snapshot for copy: 1) Invite - hook: "Real inference numbers, actionable levers" + 1-sentence summary + CTA. 2) Reminder - add speaker creds + 2 datapoints teased. 3) Last-chance - social proof + countdown. 4) Post - recording + 3 top takeaways + link to report.
Noah Rivera: Operational note: fold in throttling guard rails. If batch_send_size > 20k, autosplit into 10k chunks with 15m pause. Add retry for soft bounces at 2h and 24h.
Deliverability Bot: Also add a seed test for Google Postmaster metrics 48h pre-send. If spam rate >0.3% in seeds, hold campaign.
Jules Ford: For AEs: include private RSVP link with UTM param ae_owner_id. For trialers include 1-click register (prefill via querystring).
Priya Shah: Ops Bot 14 create campaign draft and checklist; assign: segments (Jules), subject tests (Priya), deliverability QA (Noah). Schedule dry-run 5 days before launch.
Ops Bot: Draft created: "Benchmark Q3 10 Launch 10 Newsletter + Webinar Series". Tasks created and assigned with due dates. Dry-run scheduled for 5 days prior.
Noah Rivera: I'll assemble seed lists and run ESP throttling sims tomorrow. Sharing the draft CSV filters after.
Priya Shah: Perfect. I'll drop short-form copy for invite + reminder into the campaign doc by EOD. Thanks team :raised_hands:
